name: Optimised Gait
mechanics: When another friendly Mechanical unit attacks an enemy adjacent to Exitor-Rho, he deals two hits of Energy damage to that enemy.
If that enemy is defeated by a friendly Mechanical unit or the triggered attack, Exitor-Rho moves onto its hex.
breakpoint_notes: Requires Exitor-Rho to remain adjacent to the target while other friendly Mechanical units attack it.

sources.notes: Current passive ability text; the API identifier uses American spelling.
